domain: Accepted flat closed create_cty, saturated closed snapshot application without promotion, ordinary Unit replacement, and their declared failure prefixes

families.name: contract entry and shape checking
families.local_construction: Fixed Invalid_argument value, bounded closure environments, intermediate nine-field effects and final nine-field cty; existing literal/type/term references are retained.
families.finite_descent: The straight-line body calls finite pre/post/formal lists and persistent maps. Each callback has the row below; empty lists still have a finite base invocation.
families.numeric_boundary: Result projection's List.length operands are type-symbol argument arities; no counter records the number of contract entries or effect records.

families.name: free-variable caches and restoration
families.local_construction: Fixed map-client closures; cached binder support is read. Ordinary map construction and occurrence coefficients retain their accepted kernel obligations.
families.finite_descent: Ordinary child/branch lists and finite cached-support maps; this traversal does not recursively open a binder or chase its saved images.
families.numeric_boundary: Wvs.restore remains a shared lookup service; its local caller does not allocate an Ident.

families.name: closed type projection and matching
families.local_construction: Fixed type nodes/records, list cells, closure groups, seen ref, Some result, substitution record and fixed mismatch exception. A pure closed field returns unchanged after the closedness walk.
families.finite_descent: Projection and matching recurse into proper type arguments. Flat references have no nested region/type arguments; matching may stop early. Valid source type graphs are finite and acyclic.
families.numeric_boundary: Concrete nullary snapshots/references and binary function types give type arity at most two; Unit has arity zero. Hsty/Hsity calls remain owner-service cuts.

families.name: read-only stored type closure
families.local_construction: Only fixed traversal closures and imported finite map operations; no opened binder, substituted term or fresh owner.
families.finite_descent: Proper term/pattern children, every saved image, every trigger group and element, and explicit quantified variable types. Empty trigger groups need their own list-spine witness even though they add no term visit.
families.numeric_boundary: These lists are traversed by structural fold, not by a native counter accumulating their total size. The mathematical witness may exceed a native integer.

families.name: flat effects and diagnostic prefixes
families.local_construction: Fixed map-client closures, intermediate effects and fixed StaleVariable/BadGhostWrite exception values; all earlier map work remains spent.
families.finite_descent: Finite read/write/field/reset maps. Pure values stop at purity; a flat reference reaches only its own region. A failing diagnostic iterates a finite reset set and raises before subsequent phases.
families.numeric_boundary: No new effect-size scalar or owner is introduced. Existing map height/cardinality obligations remain imported.

families.name: escape and defensive reset
families.local_construction: Fixed substitution record and field callback closure; escape/map operations keep their accepted request sequence. Defensive and final effects are separate fixed records.
families.finite_descent: Each finite write entry and each of its fields; pure field type trees and finite escape sets. Empty region/type parameter lists prevent instantiation recursion.
families.numeric_boundary: No field-value-sized string, byte array or native vector is constructed.

families.name: application prefix and failure envelope
families.local_construction: Fixed apply/cut/oldie tuples and closure environments. Map candidate add is charged before possible type mismatch as an envelope for either argument evaluation order.
families.finite_descent: Apply removes one formal/actual pair. Saturation makes cut take its empty base. Failed pair j stops before later pairs and post-apply term map construction.
families.numeric_boundary: The argument traversal has no running native index. No Ident is created here; partial application and oldie rebuilding remain residual.

families.name: application specifications and wrappers
families.local_construction: One ordinary Tvar per formal map entry, rebuilt specification list cells, fixed cty, Capp variant and cexp. Same-type substitution itself retains the accepted kernel bound.
families.finite_descent: Finite actual map and specification lists, then accepted well-founded case-free substitution. Nullary early return still retains its preceding application prefix.
families.numeric_boundary: No-promotion and same-type gates exclude eff_inst/type-changing substitution. fs_tuple_ids lookup remains a shared service.

families.name: ordinary Unit replacement
families.local_construction: Fixed preid/Ident/vsymbol, ordinary term/list/epsilon/cty records and discarded rho preid. Unit type constructors have fixed nodes; inherited closing kernel owns its binder work.
families.finite_descent: All tuple argument lists are empty. Equality has exactly two arguments. The arity-zero tuple memos were populated at module initialization, so no cold tuple-symbol creation loop or generated name is entered.
families.numeric_boundary: Two Hsty requests, one Hsity and one Ident registration retain the accepted shared owner history. No additional registration is inferred from the rho preid.

families.name: list controls and application adapters
families.local_construction: List nodes and partial-application closures have fixed native reservations; stack adjustments are fixed immediates. No argument-count-scaled block is used in these source-selected calls.
families.finite_descent: List recursion consumes the list; unrolled native map loops consume elements. Curry stages consume a fixed arity (at most eleven in the retained superset); source helper/callback arguments are the finite functions listed above.
families.numeric_boundary: List.length occurs only at the selected type/Unit arity checks (at most two/zero); no cumulative stack/heap volume is stored or checked.

indirect_calls: The native direct reference inventory is not asserted to be a complete indirect call graph. Source List/Extmap callback arguments above provide those joins; constant-closure code pointers are separately reconciled to ELF data.
physical_total_disposition: Cumulative local frame/closure byte pricing is intentionally not computed and is not a remaining representation obligation. Fixed per-request headers, actual arity arithmetic and finite source descent are sufficient under the existing physical resource premise.
